question: rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first

WITH yearly_stats AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS centre_name,
        SUM("Enrolled Kids") AS total_enrolled_2023,
        SUM("Avg Daily Present") AS total_present_2023,
        SUM(enrolment) AS total_enrolled_2024,
        SUM(average_attendance) AS total_present_2024
    FROM attendance_2023
    GROUP BY "Centre"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        centre_name,
        NULL AS total_enrolled_2023,
        NULL AS total_present_2023,
        SUM(enrolment) AS total_enrolled_2024,
        SUM(average_attendance) AS total_present_2024
    FROM attendance_2024
    GROUP BY centre_name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        centre_name,
        SUM(total_enrolled_2023) AS total_enrolled_2023,
        SUM(total_present_2023) AS total_present_2023,
        SUM(total_enrolled_2024) AS total_enrolled_2024,
        SUM(total_present_2024) AS total_present_2024
    FROM yearly_stats
    GROUP BY centre_name
),
pct_change AS (
    SELECT
        centre_name,
        (
            (CAST(total_present_2024 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_enrolled_2024, 0)) * 100
        ) - (
            (CAST(total_present_2023 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_enrolled_2023, 0)) * 100
        ) AS pct_change
    FROM combined
)
SELECT
    centre_name,
    pct_change
FROM pct_change
ORDER BY pct_change ASC;
